name: calendar-link
description: One joined identity between a Google Calendar event and an appointment row: the Google event id (scoped to its calendar, so two calendars never share a link) and the appointment sourceKey it was imported from or exported to, the last Google `updated` the sync applied, the fingerprint of the local row at that instant, and a pending conflict note until the two sides converge. Every field is managed: links exist only through the calendar-sync package, and no client can create, forge or rewrite one.
